Public Interest Litigation allows any person to approach the court for the protection of public interest.

It improves access to justice for weaker sections.
Public Interest Litigation allows any person to approach the court for the protection of public interest.

items: Under PIL, locus standi is relaxed so that any person can move the court for the protection of public interest.
The key objective of PIL frequently asked in exams is improving access to justice for weaker sections.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Public Interest Litigation enables any person to approach the court for public interest protection.
It serves to significantly improve access to justice for weaker sections.
